name: gameboy
revisions_note: the hardware revisions the two models stand for, named as the test suites name them; a DMG cartridge on the CGB model runs in CGB mode (no DMG-compatibility mode)
statement: The Game Boy and Game Boy Color as one card-IR module: the LR35902 instruction cards, the hardware cards (memory map, interrupts, timer, serial, joypad, cartridge with MBC1/2/3/5, PPU, DMA/HDMA, CGB registers, APU) and this card's main loop. The boot ROM is not used; power_on sets the documented post-boot state.
